scheme_name.value: PM-YASASVI: Top Class College Education for OBC EBC and DNT Students

evidence.text: PM-YASASVI Top Class College Education for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
Top Class College Education Scholarship Scheme

implementing_authority.value: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India

evidence.text: Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, MoSJE

target_beneficiaries.value: OBC, EBC, and DNT students admitted to notified Top Class Higher Education Institutions

evidence.text: Students belonging to OBC, EBC and DNT categories studying in notified top class institutions

education_level.value: Full-time Degree / Diploma course in notified Top Class Educational Institutions

evidence.text: Full time degree/diploma course in notified top class institutions (IITs, NITs, IIMs, AIIMS, NLU, etc.)

income_criteria.value: Total annual family income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 2.50 Lakh per annum

evidence.text: Annual family income from all sources does not exceed Rs. 2.50 Lakh

academic_criteria.value: Admitted to notified top class institution as per full-time course admission norms

evidence.text: Admitted into notified top class institution
OBC, EBC, and DNT categories with 30% slots reserved for girl students
4-component package covering tuition fee, living expenses, books allowance, and computer purchase

value: Full tuition fee and non-refundable charges up to Rs. 2.00 Lakh per annum for private institutions (actual fee for government institutions)
Living expenses of Rs. 3,000 per month (Rs. 36,000 per annum)
Books and stationery allowance of Rs. 5,000 per annum
One-time assistance of Rs. 45,000 for computer/laptop with accessories

evidence.text: Tuition fee up to Rs. 2.00 Lakh/year, Living expenses Rs. 3,000/month, Books Rs. 5,000/year, Computer Rs. 45,000 one-time
